page.heading: Skills

menu.import: Import from a file or archive

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is reusable review guidance. Write one, or import a markdown file or an archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

page.deleteConfirm: Delete the skill "{name}"? Agents lose it from their prompt.

drawer.title: Import a skill
drawer.subtitle: A markdown file, or an archive containing one

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the front matter or the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Stored as data and wrapped in the prompt — never executed as instructions.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag every conditional a diff adds whose alternative path no test exercises.
fields.descriptionHint: This is the skill’s interface — what decides whether it applies. Write it as an instruction, not a topic: “Flag N+1 queries and missing indexes” beats “about performance”.
fields.bodyHint: Appended to the agent’s prompt as its own block, in the order the agent lists it.
fields.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

What to flag, how to report it, what not to flag.

importer.pick: Choose a .md file or a .zip archive
importer.previewTitle: This is what would be saved
importer.skippedHint: Only the skill’s markdown is read. Everything else in the archive is listed here and never decompressed — an imported skill cannot run anything.
importer.trustBody: An imported skill goes into the prompt as data, wrapped like the diff, and stays disabled until you read it and enable it yourself.
importer.saved: Imported “{name}” — disabled until you enable it.

detailPage.bodyHint: Markdown. Saving a changed body snapshots the previous one.

versions.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# version} other {# versions}}. Every body edit snapshots the text it replaced.
versions.loadError: Could not load this skill's history.
versions.diffStat: v{version} compared with the current v{current} — {added} added, {removed} removed.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore the body from v{version}? It is written forward as a new version, so nothing in the history is lost.
